As Apple (AAPL) Market Value Declined, Holder High Pointe Capital Management Has Cut Position; Tortoise Investment Management Has Increased Holding in Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) as Market Valuation Rose
May 2, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Tortoise Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Intuitive Surgical Inc (ISRG) by 204.42% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tortoise Investment Management Llc bought 832 shares as the company’s stock rose 11.58% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1,239 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $452,000, up from 407 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tortoise Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Intuitive Surgical Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $50.49B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.43% or $1.92 during the last trading session, reaching $445.63. About 213,217 shares traded. Intuitive Surgical, Inc. (NASDAQ:ISRG) has risen 58.43% since May 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 46.88% the S&P500.
High Pointe Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 50.28% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. High Pointe Capital Management Llc sold 4,954 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 4,899 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $829,000, down from 9,853 at the end of the previous reported quarter. High Pointe Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $891.61 billion market cap company. The stock increased 3.91% or $6.62 during the last trading session, reaching $175.72. About 37.44 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
